messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: [INCIDENT] spike in 5xxs for /v1/embeddings starting 16:07 UTC. routing fallback count up 4.8k in last 3m. alert_id=INC-20260315-01

sara (oncall): taking this. paging liam + jasper. any early hypothesis?

liam (runtime): seeing a lot of requests for alias `customer-embed-alpha` being routed to a chat/generation path (gen-chat-v3). embeddings -> chat causes schema errors + 500s on the runtime. probable variant mapping problem.

jasper (infra): this lines up with the alias-service deploy ~16:00 UTC (deploy: git sha c0ff33a). quick config diff I pulled:

```
- fallback_order: ["embed", "instruct", "chat"]
+ fallback_order: ["chat", "instruct", "embed"]
```

That change would prefer chat variants when an alias collides. looks accidental.

sara (oncall): ugh. can we hotfix routing to stop embedding requests going to gen-chat? need mitigation first, then RCA.

liam (runtime): recommended mitigation: set an explicit route override for the alias to the most recent embed-compatible variant, and pin region to us-west where traffic concentrated. running command now:

```
# temporary routing override
rwctl route set --alias customer-embed-alpha --target embed-quantized-v1 --scope region=us-west --ttl 1h --reason "emergency stopgap for embed->chat fallback"
```

ops-bot: route update acknowledged. change_id=chg-20260315-99 trace=trc-a1b2. status=applied :white_check_mark:

maria (support): customer-impact: 7 paid tenants reported incorrect embeddings (search mismatch) and 2 support tickets opened. roughly 6000 API calls failed in the window; largest tenant (acme-corp) reported spike in latency and empty vector results.

sara (oncall): suppress noisy alerts for the alias while we monitor. @ops-bot can you mute alert rule INC-EMBED-5XX for 30m for this scope?

ops-bot: alert INC-EMBED-5XX muted for alias=customer-embed-alpha for 30m (muted_by=sara).

jasper (infra): root cause summary so far: a default fallback-order change got shipped without compatibility checks; alias resolution now picks a chat variant if name overlaps. bad assumption in alias-service that variant interfaces are interchangeable.

liam (runtime): quick smoke: embedding requests to `embed-quantized-v1` now show error-rate down to baseline, p50 latency back to normal. I'll keep an eye on p99 for the next 15m.

maria (support): drafting customer note: "We've applied a routing override for your alias which should restore embeddings. We're investigating a config change that caused some aliases to resolve to chat variants; we will update in 60 minutes." want review?

sara (oncall): looks fine. please include apology + how to verify (example curl). add contact for dedicated support channel.

maria (support): suggested verification snippet for customers:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"customer-embed-alpha","input":"hello world"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
```

ops-bot: metrics snapshot (16:12 UTC): embed 5xx rate -> 0.8% (was 18% at peak), total embed API calls in window=6.1k, affected aliases observed=1, top region=us-west.

jasper (infra): next steps: revert the fallback_order change from c0ff33a -> patch to reinstate safe default + add a validation gate so alias-resolve checks interface compatibility. I'll open an urgent PR and coordinate a canary.

liam (runtime): deployment plan: hotfix to alias-service -> canary in us-west (15m) -> eu -> global. rollback if any regressions. also adding a test matrix to CI that exercises alias->variant compatibility on embed/chat/instruct typing.

sara (oncall): assign followups: jasper -> PR + rollback; liam -> monitor + deploy plan; maria -> customer comms + ticket triage. Handoff to night oncall @jasper after we confirm global stabilization.

maria (support): posting first customer update now. will post internal incident timeline in incident board.

pagerbot: incident updated -> status=mitigated (routing override applied). next update scheduled in 30m.

sara (oncall): thanks all. leaving channel open for rapid followups. if new errors appear ping me directly. :thumbsup:
